name: falcon-snort-bi-e5-base-v2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from intfloat/e5-base-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-11-08. A full contrastive finetune of intfloat/e5-base-v2 (109M, BERT-base, hidden 768, 12 layers, 512 max positions, 768 output dims) trained to map cyber-threat-intelligence text and SNORT rules into one embedding space with symmetric InfoNCE / NT-Xent over in-batch negatives - the SNORT sibling of falcon-yara-bi-e5-base-v2 and falcon-snort-bi-all-mpnet-base-v2 from the same author. Config is the base's unchanged (BertModel, 12x768 with intermediate 3072, vocab 30522); safetensors total is 109,482,240 against the base record's 109,482,752, a 512-parameter difference that is not explained on the card, so the tensor set is same-shape rather than literally identical. Both benchmark rows are the repo's own SNORT/CTI retrieval test split: the card's 'pretrained' row is the untrained e5-base-v2 backbone measured on the same split with the same harness, so this is a genuine same-table base comparison, but it is a private domain benchmark and not BEIR or MTEB - do not compare it to the MTEB rows on the base record. The gain is large because the base has no notion of SNORT syntax at all. THE RELEASED CHECKPOINT IS run_3: the repo's final commit message reads 'FALCON best checkpoint - best run r3 (test_f1=0.9329)', after an earlier commit that had shipped r0 on validation loss, so r3's numbers are the ones recorded here. All five runs land within 0.004 recall@1 of each other (0.9526-0.9564) so the choice barely moves the headline. Licence cc-by-nc-nd-4.0 - non-commercial, no derivatives - repo created 2026-05-28. Single test split, single seed per configuration, no variance reported.
